description: This file is a JavaScript implementation of the Bootstrap ScrollSpy plugin, version 2.0.4, providing scrollspy functionality for web pages, including class definitions, methods, and plugin initialization code.

classes.name: ScrollSpy
classes.description: A class that manages scrollspy behavior, tracking scroll position and updating active navigation links.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Recalculates the positions of target elements for scrollspy.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Handles scroll events to determine which navigation item should be active based on scroll position.

methods.name: activate
methods.description: Activates a specific target, updating the UI to reflect the current section.
